title: •Master Qui-Gon
caption: •Master Qui-Gon (V)
game_text: Deploys -1 to {episode1} locations. If you just lost Force to opponent’s Effect, may ▲ an {episode1} Interrupt (except Control) or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. Immune to Disarmed, You Are Beaten, and attrition.
lore: Jedi Master currently not on the Council. Although he serves the Council well, there have been times when he has defied their wishes to pursue a path he believes is right.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 6 / ABILITY 7 / JEDI MASTER (label only); deploy 7 / forfeit 7 (printed 8/9). Icon column: warrior. Jedi Master (blue-blade disc, Coruscant frame; printed card shows the Coruscant ring and an Episode I icon beside the lore). Two inline black EPISODE I circles → {episode1}; ▲ where the stub expands. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Margin credits on two lines each. Lore matches the scan and the V0 remake. Base scan 350 px; copyright 2001 legible on the V0 remake (SE-style). Modern: V0-L-masterquigon.gif (745 px); _ai and VB5 variants also exist, not downloaded. Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
